item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description:
This is just for context on tone/format — I have what I need to write the brief directly.
Today, let's talk Hydration. It's a packed day, work check-ins stacked against personal time, a dog walk, and a dinner out later tonight. Easy to let water slide when you're moving between tasks and people all day. Heat, talking, and a later meal all drain you faster than you'd notice. Keep a bottle in reach and refill it each time you switch tasks. Action: drink a full glass of water right now, before your 12:30.
